answers.rationale: Historic District is the calibrated choice because the stated dinners are there and no rental car is planned. Prior no-car leisure trips favored walkable hotel bases, but this is not a fixed hotel-area preference; the current trip facts are sufficient.

A small non-hazardous badge-scanner box for a registered guest arriving the next day belongs at the hotel front desk under the reservation. Earlier hotel-package cases were conditional on package size and guest status, not evidence of a fixed receiver preference.

The brewery receiving dock is the direct receiver because its Wednesday-morning receiving window is explicitly available before arrival. Prior demo-case plans likewise used the operating-site receiver when receiving was confirmed; this remains context-dependent rather than a stable preference.
